currentLine.name: 0.3.x
currentLine.note: 0.3.6 Bureaucramancer Personal Protocol is open/current work; merge, deploy and live QA are not assumed by this board.

statusDefinitions.conditional: Create only when cited evidence justifies it.
statusDefinitions.blocked_by_gate: Do not activate until named gates pass.
statusDefinitions.later: Future horizon; not current implementation permission.

tasks.title: Bureaucramancer Personal Protocol
acceptanceEvidence: Task acceptance criteria are satisfied
Focused persistence, concurrency and party-boss tests pass
Required full repository check is recorded

tasks.title: Deep review and fixes before merge
acceptanceEvidence: No unresolved blocker or important review findings
Risky in-scope fixes are applied before merge
Missing regression tests identified by review are present

tasks.title: Critical 0.3.x Telegram smoke
acceptanceEvidence: Compact smoke record lists environment and tested flows
Every critical flow has pass, fail or explicit blocker
Reward replay and stale callback checks are included

tasks.title: Current-state and canon reconciliation
acceptanceEvidence: README, product brief, roadmap, task index and Codex context agree on the current line
Kharakternyk balance contradiction is removed
Superseded drafts are clearly archived or labeled
Local Markdown links pass

tasks.title: Production feature maturity matrix
acceptanceEvidence: Each flagged feature has implemented, default, production-enabled and manual-QA fields
The matrix contains no secrets
Unknown production facts are labeled unknown rather than inferred

tasks.title: Backup and restore proof
acceptanceEvidence: Runbook matches the actual production storage target
A backup is restored into a separate environment or copy
Owner, verification date and retention decision are recorded

tasks.title: Post-0.3.5 performance sample
acceptanceEvidence: Representative sampled or slow route records are collected
DB, compute and Telegram time are separated where instrumented
A ranked next-action note is produced without speculative infrastructure changes

tasks.title: Measured Alpha Reliability Fix
acceptanceEvidence: The task cites one measured or reproduced root cause
A regression test covers the defect
Before and after evidence is recorded

tasks.title: Feedback Inbox MVP
acceptanceEvidence: Feedback is durable and voluntarily submitted
Read or export access is admin-only and bounded
Player-facing privacy copy is present
No XP, gold, items, achievements or public feed entries are granted

tasks.title: Public Front Door Refresh
acceptanceEvidence: Site copy matches current default-on and flagged capabilities
The news channel and play CTA are reachable
Empty presence and mobile layout are verified
No unverified production feature is promised

tasks.title: Alpha Funnel Snapshot
acceptanceEvidence: Activation and D1/D7 definitions are documented
Aggregate solo and social milestones are queryable
No public personal rows or tiny-cohort identity leaks exist

tasks.title: Economy Health Snapshot
acceptanceEvidence: Gold, Iskrokamin, medical, upgrade and tournament source or sink categories are documented
Aggregate balance and flow report is reproducible
Reporting is separated from reward settlement

tasks.title: Controlled tester waves
acceptanceEvidence: Each wave has an observation window and owner
Blocker and P1 findings are triaged before expansion
Wave sizes are recorded as actual observations, not assumed by this plan

tasks.title: Closed Alpha Readiness closeout
acceptanceEvidence: The 0.3.x exit checklist is signed
Known risks have owners and next actions
The next product line is explicitly approved

tasks.title: Raid Role Interaction Contract
acceptanceEvidence: Typed personal, broad and mixed scope interaction matrix exists
Ward, protocol and taunt ordering is characterized
Simulation fixtures cover small and full rosters

tasks.title: Warrior Raid Taunt
acceptanceEvidence: Single and multiple Warrior uptime is simulated
Broad redirect and mitigation ordering is tested
Deep review has no unresolved important findings

tasks.title: One new group challenge
acceptanceEvidence: Product chooses targetable adds or a second objective, not both
Reward settlement remains single-encounter and replay-safe
The choice cites raid usage or feedback evidence

tasks.title: Party History and Regrouping
acceptanceEvidence: Recent party selection is bounded and opt-in
No current location or online status leaks
No guild rank, tax or shared bank is introduced

tasks.title: Rogue Heat and Rumor design
acceptanceEvidence: The design defines use, consequences, recovery and remort behavior
Public shame remains out of scope
No schema task is opened before the loop is approved

tasks.title: Bestiary Collection MVP
acceptanceEvidence: Only provable encounter, win or trophy records count
Collection is private by default
No power reward or invented history is added

tasks.title: Old Altar Gold-only MVP
acceptanceEvidence: Economy snapshot supports the sink decision
Favor is bounded and current-life scoped
Item offerings and separate grove location remain out of scope

tasks.title: Consumable Use Audit
acceptanceEvidence: Every candidate is classified as usable, flavor or misleading
One narrow implementation family is selected
A broad shop or crafting rewrite is not silently included

tasks.title: Season Zero
acceptanceEvidence: One theme and bounded start/end dates are selected
Rewards are cosmetic or tightly bounded without FOMO-critical power
A post-season report plan exists

tasks.title: Guild discovery decision
acceptanceEvidence: Repeat-party usage supports a persistent group identity
Moderation ownership is defined
Shared reward and abuse risks have a written go or no-go decision
